scripts.ext:dev: npm run ext:build && (npm run ext:watch & web-ext run --config web-ext-config.cjs)
scripts.ext:zip: mkdir -p build && rm -f build/extension.zip && cd build/extension && zip -r ../extension.zip .
scripts.ext:package: npm run ext:build && npm run ext:zip
scripts.ext:zip-source: mkdir -p build && zip -r build/extension-source.zip src public scripts extension-assets index.html popup.html package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts web-ext-config.cjs README.md
scripts.ext:release: npm run ext:package && npm run ext:zip-source
